MLP_NILAMBUR.desc: Cross a hanging bridge to the world's oldest teak plantation, then the Teak Museum, Adyanpara falls and the forest at Nedumkayam.
MLP_NILAMBUR.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Malappuram KSRTC bus station · Tirur railway station · Calicut Airport (on request) (Tirur 7:00 · Malappuram 7:45)
9:15 AM — Conolly's Plot: 1840s teak on the Chaliyar bank, over a hanging footbridge. (Entry own expense)
11:00 AM — Teak Museum, Nilambur: Teak history, a giant root and a garden trail. Lunch in Nilambur after, own expense. (Check closing day)
1:45 PM — Adyanpara falls: A wide cascade over rocks near Kurumbalangode. (Closed in heavy rain)
3:45 PM — Nedumkayam forest: Forest on the Karimpuzha, an old wooden bridge and Dawson's grave. (Forest rules apply)
7:15 PM — Drop-off: Malappuram, Tirur station, Calicut Airport, or your own stop on the way
MLP_NILAMBUR.gtk:
🗓️ Opening days: The Teak Museum keeps a weekly closing day and Conolly's Plot follows forest timings — we confirm both before your date. Waterfalls and the forest stop can close at short notice after heavy rain.
🌉 Hanging bridge: The footbridge sways and takes a limited number of people at a time — the staff count you across. Hold the rails; not ideal for anyone with a fear of heights.
💧 At the falls: Rocks are slippery all year and the pools are deep — viewing only, no bathing. Leeches in the monsoon months on the forest paths.
🚌 Long day: About 2 hours each way on the road, with Tirur and Malappuram pickups. Drop-off in reverse order: Malappuram first, then Tirur.
MLP_NILAMBUR.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
MLP_NILAMBUR.exc: Lunch; Conolly's Plot, museum and falls entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
MLP_NILAMBUR.carry: Shoes with good grip; Leech / insect repellent; Cash for entry fees; Light rain jacket

MLP_PONNANI.desc: Thunchan Parambu, the Mamankam riverbank at Tirunavaya, old Ponnani's great mosque and harbour, and the estuary where the Nila meets the sea.
MLP_PONNANI.itin:
7:45 AM — Pickup: Malappuram KSRTC bus station · Tirur railway station · Calicut Airport (on request) (Malappuram 7:45 · Tirur 8:30)
9:00 AM — Thunchan Parambu, Tirur: Birthplace of Ezhuthachan, the father of Malayalam. (Check timings)
10:30 AM — Tirunavaya: Navamukunda temple and the old Mamankam riverbank. (Temple dress code)
12:15 PM — Ponnani Juma Masjid: 16th-century mosque of Zainuddin Makhdoom. Lunch after, own expense. (Seen from outside)
2:30 PM — Ponnani harbour & beach: Fishing boats, the lighthouse and the river mouth. (No sea bathing)
4:15 PM — Padinjarekkara estuary: The sandbar where the Nila and the Tirur river meet the sea.
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Malappuram, Tirur station, Calicut Airport, or your own stop on the way
MLP_PONNANI.gtk:
🛕 Temple & mosque: Tirunavaya: men usually go in shirtless, women in saree or churidar; entry inside is at the temple's discretion. Ponnani Juma Masjid is a working mosque — we see it from outside; entry inside only if the committee allows.
👗 What to wear: Clothes covering shoulders and knees for the temple and the mosque area. Sandals that slip off easily.
🌊 At the sea: The river mouth has strong currents and shifting sand — paddling and swimming are not allowed on this tour. Monsoon (June–Sept): beach stops are short or skipped.
🗓️ Fridays: Friday midday prayers make Ponnani town very busy — we may reverse the order on Fridays. Pickup times are shared the evening before.
MLP_PONNANI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
MLP_PONNANI.exc: Lunch; Any entry or offerings; Tolls and parking (private trips)
MLP_PONNANI.carry: Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Slip-on sandals; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for offerings & snacks

MLP_KADALUNDI.desc: Birds on the Kadalundi mudflats, dhows built by hand at Beypore, a walk out on the breakwater, then Kozhikode's halwa street and a beach sunset.
MLP_KADALUNDI.itin:
7:45 AM — Pickup: Malappuram KSRTC bus station · Tirur railway station · Calicut Airport (on request) (Malappuram 7:45 · Tirur 8:30)
9:30 AM — Kadalundi bird sanctuary: Mangroves and mudflats at the river mouth — herons and migrants. (Boat ride paid direct)
11:45 AM — Beypore uru yard: Craftsmen building giant wooden dhows by hand. (Ask before photos)
12:30 PM — Beypore breakwater: Walk out to sea at the Chaliyar mouth. Lunch after, own expense. (No sea bathing)
2:45 PM — SM Street, Kozhikode: The old sweet street — Kozhikodan halwa and the bazaar. (Walking street)
4:00 PM — Kozhikode beach: Seafront promenade, old pier pillars and sunset snacks.
7:15 PM — Drop-off: Malappuram, Tirur station, Calicut Airport, or your own stop on the way
MLP_KADALUNDI.gtk:
🐦 Birding: November to April is the best season for migrant birds; a few resident birds all year. Low tide shows the most birds — timings shift with the tide, we plan around it.
⛵ Uru yard: The dhow yards are working sites — watch from where the craftsmen allow, away from timber and tools. Work stops on some days; you may see a hull, not a full build.
🌊 Sea & breakwater: Walk only on the paved top of the breakwater; no climbing on the side rocks. No sea bathing on this tour; in rough monsoon weather the breakwater may be closed.
🚌 Long day: Drop-off from about 6:30 PM: Tirur first, then Malappuram. Calicut Airport drop on request — tell us when you book.
MLP_KADALUNDI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
MLP_KADALUNDI.exc: Lunch and snacks; Boat ride at Kadalundi; Tolls and parking (private trips)
MLP_KADALUNDI.carry: Binoculars if you have them; Hat and sunscreen; Comfortable walking shoes; Cash for the boat & halwa

MLP_KODIKUTHIMALA.desc: Morning mist on Kodikuthimala, the 'Ooty of Malappuram', then Kottakkal's century-old Arya Vaidya Sala and a sunset over the town from Kottakkunnu hill.
MLP_KODIKUTHIMALA.itin:
7:15 AM — Pickup: Malappuram KSRTC bus station · Tirur railway station · Calicut Airport (on request) (Tirur 7:15 · Malappuram 8:00)
9:00 AM — Kodikuthimala: A breezy hilltop with a watchtower and wide views over the Valluvanad hills. (Entry own expense)
2:00 PM — Kottakkal Arya Vaidya Sala: Kerala's famous Ayurveda house, founded in 1902: the old campus, temple front and medicine shop. Lunch in Kottakkal before, own expense. (Outside visit)
4:00 PM — Kottakkunnu hill park: Gardens on the old fort hill above Malappuram town — the best sunset view in town. (Entry own expense)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Malappuram, Tirur station, Calicut Airport, or your own stop on the way
MLP_KODIKUTHIMALA.gtk:
⛰️ The hill: The last stretch up Kodikuthimala is a narrow, steep road; then a short walk to the top. Mornings are misty and cool from November to February; the view may be hidden on cloudy days.
🌿 Arya Vaidya Sala: A working hospital and medicine maker — we see the campus from the public areas only, quietly. Consultations and treatments are not part of this tour; book them direct if you wish.
👗 What to wear: Clothes covering shoulders and knees near the Kottakkal temple. Shoes with good grip for the hilltop and the watchtower steps.
🚉 Pickup points: Tirur first, then Malappuram — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off: Malappuram first, then Tirur, or your stop on the way.
MLP_KODIKUTHIMALA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
MLP_KODIKUTHIMALA.exc: Lunch; Hilltop and park entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
MLP_KODIKUTHIMALA.carry: Light jacket for the morning; Shoes with good grip; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for entry fees

MLP_CCJ.desc: Flying from Calicut International at Karipur? We pick you up at your door in Malappuram, Manjeri, Kottakkal or Tirur and drop you at the right terminal — or meet you at arrivals.
MLP_CCJ.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Malappuram, Manjeri, Kottakkal, Tirur or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~30 km via Kondotty: About 45 minutes to 1 hour on the Malappuram–Kozhikode road (NH 966) via Morayur and Kondotty.
Drop-off — Calicut International Airport: Domestic or international departures at Karipur. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
MLP_CCJ.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 4 hours before an international flight and 3 hours before a domestic one. Malappuram, Morayur and Kondotty junctions jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 Which terminal?: Karipur has separate domestic and international terminals on one campus. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Gulf flights mean big bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller for families. Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags.
🔁 Landing at Karipur?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
MLP_CCJ.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
MLP_CCJ.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal noted; Water for the drive

MLP_COK.desc: Flying out of Cochin International? We pick you up at your door in Malappuram, Kottakkal or Tirur and drop you at the right terminal — or meet you at arrivals and bring you home.
MLP_COK.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Malappuram, Kottakkal, Tirur, Valanchery or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~150 km via Thrissur: About 4 hours via Kottakkal, Kuttippuram, Kunnamkulam, Thrissur and NH 544 — longer at peak hours.
Drop-off — Cochin International Airport: Domestic (T1) or international (T3) departures. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
MLP_COK.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 7 hours before an international flight and 6 hours before a domestic one. Edappal, Kunnamkulam, Thrissur and Angamaly jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 Which terminal?: Domestic flights use T1; international flights use T3. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Gulf flights mean big bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller for families. Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags.
🔁 Landing in Kochi?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
MLP_COK.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
MLP_COK.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
MLP_COK.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T3) noted; Water for the drive

MLP_WAYANAD.desc: Up the nine hairpins of the Thamarassery ghat to Kerala's green north: a forest lake, the country's largest earth dam and Edakkal's ancient carvings — your own vehicle and driver.
MLP_WAYANAD.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Wayanad: From your door in Malappuram — about 100 km via Manjeri, Areekode, Mukkam and the Thamarassery ghat, roughly 4 hours with breakfast. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · morning — Lakkidi viewpoint & Pookode Lake: The view back down the ghat, then a forest lake right on the way in. (Boating optional, paid direct)
Day 1 · afternoon — Banasura Sagar Dam: India's largest earth dam, with green islands in the reservoir. (Entry & boating own expense)
Day 2 · morning — Edakkal Caves: A short, steep climb to caves with prehistoric rock carvings. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 2 · or swap in — Soochipara or Kuruva: A forest waterfall or bamboo-raft river islands instead of the caves. (Seasonal · we check if open)
Day 2 · 1:30 PM — Drive home: Lunch, then down the ghat; back at your door in Malappuram by about 6 PM.
MLP_WAYANAD.gtk:
🪨 Edakkal Caves: Closed on Mondays — we swap the day order if needed. The climb is steep: not ideal for elders or small children.
🌧️ Seasonal spots: Kuruva Island closes in the monsoon and has a daily visitor cap; falls can shut after heavy rain. We check on the day and swap stops.
🏨 Your stay: You book your resort or homestay; Kalpetta and Vythiri are central. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
⛰️ The ghat: Thamarassery ghat jams on weekends and holidays. We start early and climb before the midday trucks.
MLP_WAYANAD.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Wayanad sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
MLP_WAYANAD.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, boating and trek fees; Tolls and parking
MLP_WAYANAD.carry: Walking shoes; Raincoat; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

MLP_OOTY.desc: Through Nilambur's teak country and up the Nadukani ghat to the Nilgiris: Pykara's falls and pine forests on the way in, Ooty's lake, gardens and highest peak — your vehicle, your pace.
MLP_OOTY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Ooty: From your door in Malappuram — about 145 km via Nilambur, the Nadukani ghat and Gudalur, roughly 7 hours with stops. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · late morning — Pykara Falls & Lake: Waterfalls and a boat house on a forest-fringed lake, right on the road in. (Entry & boating own expense)
Day 1 · afternoon — Pine Forest & Ooty Lake: A short walk among tall pines, then an easy evening by the lake. (Boating optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Doddabetta & Botanical Garden: The highest point in the Nilgiris, then Ooty's 1840s gardens. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · 12:30 PM — Drive home: Early lunch, then down through Gudalur and the Nadukani ghat in daylight; home by about 6 PM.
MLP_OOTY.gtk:
🎫 Nilgiris e-pass: Every vehicle entering the Nilgiris needs a Tamil Nadu e-pass — we apply for it. Single-use plastic is banned: carry refillable steel bottles.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Ooty is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and green fee are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🐘 Nadukani ghat: Forest road with hairpins and elephants — we cross it only in daylight. Carry motion sickness tablets for the two ghats.
🧥 Weather: Ooty nights are cold all year — bring warm clothes. Fog on the Naduvattam stretch: we drive slow.
MLP_OOTY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Ooty sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
MLP_OOTY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry and boating tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
MLP_OOTY.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Refillable water bottle; Cash for entry fees

MLP_MYSORE.desc: Through Wayanad and the Bandipur forest to Mysore's palace and Brindavan, then the Golden Temple at Bylakuppe and the coffee hills of Coorg — home by the Makkootam ghat.
MLP_MYSORE.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Mysore: From your door, hotel, Tirur station or the KSRTC stand; about 265 km via Kozhikode, the Thamarassery ghat, Wayanad and Bandipur. (Forest road closed at night)
Day 1 · evening — Srirangapatna & Brindavan Gardens: Tipu Sultan's island fort, then the gardens and musical fountain below KRS dam. Overnight in Mysore. (Entry own expense · stay booked by you)
Day 2 · 10:00 AM — Mysore Palace & Chamundi Hill: The Wodeyars' palace of stained glass and mirrors, then the hilltop temple and city view. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Golden Temple & Raja's Seat: The Tibetan monastery at Bylakuppe, then sunset over the Coorg hills in Madikeri. Overnight there. (Modest dress · stay booked by you)
Day 3 · morning — Abbey Falls & coffee estates: A short walk down to the falls through coffee and pepper plantations. (Entry own expense)
Day 3 · ~6:30 PM — Drive home: About 245 km via Virajpet, the Makkootam ghat, Iritty and NH 66.
MLP_MYSORE.gtk:
🪪 Karnataka entry: Mysore and Coorg are in Karnataka: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🐘 Bandipur road: The forest stretch is closed to traffic from 9 PM to 6 AM — we cross in daylight. No stopping or feeding animals inside the forest.
🏰 Palace & temples: Shoes come off inside Mysore Palace — carry socks. Palace lights are on Sunday and holiday evenings. Modest dress at Chamundi and the Golden Temple.
🏨 Your stays: You book one night in Mysore and one in Madikeri; check that estate stays have road access for the vehicle. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
MLP_MYSORE.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Mysore and Coorg sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
MLP_MYSORE.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Palace, garden and entry fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
MLP_MYSORE.carry: Photo ID; Socks for the palace; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

MLP_GURUVAYUR.desc: Your own vehicle for an early darshan at Guruvayur and Mammiyoor, the Punnathur Kotta elephants, Chavakkad beach and an evening stop at Kadampuzha on the way home.
MLP_GURUVAYUR.itin:
4:30 AM — Pickup: From your door or hotel; about 70 km via Kottakkal, Edappal and Kunnamkulam. (Very early start)
6:15 AM — Guruvayur & Mammiyoor temples: Darshan at 'the Dwarka of the South' and the Shiva temple next door; lunch in town, own expense. (Hindus only · strict dress code)
12:30 PM — Punnathur Kotta: The temple's elephant yard in an old palace compound. (Entry own expense)
2:30 PM — Chavakkad beach: A wide, quiet beach with fishing boats — tea and a sea breeze. (Walk only · no swimming)
5:00 PM — Kadampuzha Devi temple: Evening darshan at the Bhagavathy temple near Valanchery. (Optional · check timings)
6:30 PM — Home: Back at your door in Malappuram.
MLP_GURUVAYUR.gtk:
👗 Dress code: Men: mundu, no shirt (a shawl is fine). Women: saree, churidar or long skirt. No jeans, shorts or T-shirts. Mundus and sarees are sold near the temple if needed.
📵 At the temple: Phones, cameras, bags and footwear are not allowed inside — use the paid counters. Queues of 2–4 hours on weekends, Ekadasi and wedding days; keep water and medicines handy.
🙏 Non-Hindu guests: The temples admit Hindus only. You can see the East Nada from outside, walk the temple town and visit the elephant yard. The beach is open to everyone.
🚐 Your day, your pace: It's your vehicle: spend longer at any stop or skip one — just tell your driver. If the queue runs long, we drop the beach or Kadampuzha to keep you home on time.
MLP_GURUVAYUR.inc: Private vehicle and driver; Temple-to-temple drives; Driver bata; No waiting charges
MLP_GURUVAYUR.exc: Meals; Offerings, special darshan & elephant-yard entry; Tolls and parking
MLP_GURUVAYUR.carry: Mundu / saree / churidar; Small pouch for medicines; Water bottle; Cash for offerings

MLP_MUNNAR.desc: Waterfalls on the climb, a full day among tea estates, Eravikulam's Nilgiri tahr and the Top Station view — Kerala's favourite hill station at an easy pace from Malappuram.
MLP_MUNNAR.itin:
Day 1 · 5:00 AM — Pickup & drive up: From your door, hotel, Tirur station or the KSRTC stand; about 250 km via Edappal, Thrissur, Angamaly and Kothamangalam.
Day 1 · 10:15 AM — Cheeyappara & Valara falls: Roadside waterfalls in the Neriamangalam forest — a short photo stop. (Fullest in the monsoon)
Day 1 · afternoon — Tea Museum & Munnar town: Lunch in town, then how tea goes from leaf to cup at Nullatanni. Overnight in Munnar. (Closed Mondays · stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Eravikulam National Park: Park buses take you up Rajamala to see the Nilgiri tahr. (Tickets online · closed ~Feb–Mar)
Day 2 · afternoon — Mattupetty, Echo Point & Top Station: Lake views and optional boating, then the high viewpoint on the Tamil Nadu border. (Entry & boating own expense)
Day 3 · 9:00 AM — Spice garden & drive home: An optional Pallivasal spice-garden walk, then down the ghat — home in Malappuram by about 5:30 PM. (Spice garden paid direct)
MLP_MUNNAR.gtk:
🐐 Eravikulam: Tickets are sold online in time slots — book a few days ahead; we can help. Closed for the tahr calving season, usually February–March; then we spend longer at Top Station.
🍃 Tea & spices: Tea estates are private land — photograph from the roadside. Spice gardens and boating are optional and paid direct.
🏨 Your stays: You book two nights; Munnar town, Pothamedu and Chithirapuram are popular. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
🧥 Weather & roads: Cool mornings, cold in December–January — bring a layer. About 7 hours each way with breaks; in heavy-rain alerts we plan to be off the ghat before dark.
MLP_MUNNAR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Munnar sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
MLP_MUNNAR.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Park, museum and boating fees; Tolls and parking
MLP_MUNNAR.carry: Warm jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

MLP_VELANKANNI.desc: A full, relaxed day at the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, Morning Star Church and the shore — from Malappuram via Palakkad and Trichy.
MLP_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 4:30 AM — Pickup: Malappuram KSRTC bus station · Tirur railway station · Calicut Airport (on request) (≈505 km via Trichy)
Day 1 · evening — Velankanni Basilica: Via Palakkad and Trichy; check in, then evening prayer at the shrine. (Lodge list shared)
Day 2 · morning — Mass & Our Lady's Tank: Mass, Our Lady's Tank and the Way of the Cross path. (Modest dress)
Day 2 · late morning — Morning Star Church & museum: The church by the shore and the museum of offerings; lunch own expense.
Day 2 · afternoon — Nadu Thittu chapel: Where Our Lady is said to have first appeared; candles and quiet prayer.
Day 2 · evening — Rosary & beach: Evening rosary and candle prayers, then sunset on the shore. (No swimming)
Day 3 · ~6:30 PM — Drop-off: Malappuram, Tirur station, Calicut Airport, or your own stop on the way (We leave at 5 AM)
MLP_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the shrine: Dress modestly; footwear off where asked, quiet in the queues. Masses run through the day in Tamil, English and other languages; we confirm the Malayalam Mass time.
🌊 The beach: The sea here is rough and drownings are reported — paddle only, never swim. Crowds are big: agree a meeting point and keep children close.
🏨 Your room: You book your own room; we share a list of pilgrim lodges near the shrine. Driver bata and night allowance are in our price.
🛣️ Long drive days: About 12 hours each way with breaks every 2–3 hours; the driver rests overnight. Interstate permit, border tax and tolls are at actual cost.
MLP_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests
MLP_VELANKANNI.exc: Your room; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
MLP_VELANKANNI.carry: Modest clothes for church; Photo ID; Hat or umbrella for the sun; Cash for offerings and candles
